title: 動詞與基本句型
subtitle: Verbs & Sentence Patterns
summary: 動詞決定整個句子的長相。搞懂及物不及物、連綴動詞、使役動詞與動狀詞，Part 5 的動詞題就不用猜。

sections.title: 及物動詞與不及物動詞

blocks.value: 及物動詞後面必須有受詞；不及物動詞後面不能直接接名詞，要接介系詞才能帶出名詞。

rows: discuss, mention, explain, approach, enter, attend, answer, contact
arrive, happen, occur, rise, remain, appear, respond
increase, change, open, run, start, continue

items.en: The shipment arrived at the warehouse yesterday.
items.note: arrive 不及物，要加 at / in

items.en: Please respond to the inquiry within 24 hours.
items.zh: 請在 24 小時內回覆詢問。

items.en: We will contact to you shortly.
items.note: contact 是及物動詞，不加 to

blocks.value: 易混淆組：rise（不及物，上升）/ raise（及物，提高）；lie（不及物，躺）/ lay（及物，放置）；sit / seat。

blocks.q: Sales figures _____ steadily since the new campaign launched.
blocks.explain: rise 是不及物動詞，句中沒有受詞，用 have risen。raise 需要受詞。

blocks.value: 授與動詞後面可以接兩個受詞：間接受詞（人）在前，直接受詞（物）在後；也可以改寫成介系詞句型。

rows: give, send, offer, show, lend, tell, pass, hand
buy, make, find, get, order, choose

items.en: The supplier sent us the revised quote.
items.zh: 供應商寄給我們修訂後的報價。

items.en: The supplier sent the revised quote to us.
Our assistant booked me a flight.
Our assistant booked a flight for me.

blocks.value: 受詞是代名詞時，通常放在前面：send it to me（不說 send me it）。
連綴動詞後面接形容詞（不是副詞），用來描述主詞的狀態。

items: be, become, remain, stay, keep, prove, turn out
感官類：look, sound, smell, taste, feel

items.en: The office remained open during the renovation.
items.zh: 整修期間辦公室維持開放。

items.note: seem 之後要用形容詞 confident

blocks.q: Despite the delay, the client remained _____ about the outcome.
blocks.explain: remained 是連綴動詞，後面要接形容詞當主詞補語。

rows: The manager had the team revise the plan.
We got the vendor to lower the price.
原形（全程）或 V-ing（進行中）
The team was made to revise the plan.

blocks.value: 受詞和動作是被動關係時，用過去分詞。

items.en: We had the contract reviewed by legal.
items.zh: 我們請法務審閱了合約。
items.note: contract 是被審閱的，用過去分詞

items.en: We had legal review the contract.

blocks.q: The supervisor made everyone _____ the safety video before starting.
blocks.explain: 使役動詞 make 後面接受詞加原形動詞。

rows: want, hope, plan, decide, agree, offer, refuse, manage, afford, fail, expect, promise
enjoy, finish, avoid, mind, suggest, consider, recommend, postpone, admit, deny, practice, quit

blocks.value: 有些動詞兩者都能接，但意思不同。

items.en: Please remember to submit the form.
I remember submitting the form last week.
items.zh: 我記得上週交過表格了。

items.en: He stopped to take a call.
He stopped taking calls after 6 p.m.
items.zh: 他六點後就不接電話了。

blocks.value: 介系詞後面一律接動名詞：look forward to seeing、be committed to improving、be used to working。這裡的 to 是介系詞不是不定詞，是多益超高頻陷阱。

blocks.q: We look forward to _____ from you at your earliest convenience.
blocks.explain: look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後面接動名詞 hearing。
